blocks.text: Monoclonal antibodies laboratory mein masnooi taur par banaye gaye molecules hain jo immune system ki pathogens (bimari phailane wale jaraseem) se larne ki salahiyat barhate hain. Monoclonal antibodies khaas antigens ko nishana banati hain, is liye yeh cancer, autoimmune disorders (jin mein immune system apne hi jism par hamla kare) aur infectious (chhoot wali) bimariyon ke ilaaj mein mo'assar hain.
Monoclonal antibodies hybridoma cells se kaise banti hain, is ka bayan Chapter 21 (Immunity) mein hai.
blocks.title: Yaad rakhein

blocks.prompt: Monoclonal antibodies se kin teen qisam ki bimariyon ka ilaaj hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Cancer, autoimmune disorders aur infectious bimariyan.

items: Monoclonal antibodies: lab mein bani, khaas antigen ko nishana banati hain.
Istemal: cancer, autoimmune disorders, infectious bimariyan.
